decisions.evidence: R1 maker: app 'assumes ... without ... automatic page metadata' (user types title). R1 client: 'you have decided I would type in the title myself every time. That is not what I want ... fetch the page title (and ideally its description and little site icon) for me automatically ... Please fold that in.' R2 maker: 'Automatic retrieval of page title, description, and site icon.'
decisions.note: Spec-review stage. Presented assumption contradicts REF-BM-02 (auto-collect title/description/favicon). Client rejects and supplies conforming behaviour -> corrective/correct. Preview-image aspect handled as a separate decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'then I can tweak that title or description if I feel like it, before or after saving.' R2 maker: 'Editable retrieved title and description before and after saving.'
decisions.note: Spec-review stage. With manual-title R1 there was no auto-collected value to edit; client supplies reference-conforming editability of auto-collected fields -> corrective/correct.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker presents generic 'searching'. R1 client: 'searching ... feels a bit thin ... I want to be able to search my tags specifically (not just stumble on them mixed into everything).' R2 maker: 'Tag-specific search.'
decisions.note: Spec-review stage. Presented plain search omits tag-specific search; client requests the missing reference requirement -> corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'if I put something in quotes I would expect it to find that exact phrase rather than the loose words.' R2 maker: 'Exact-phrase searches using quotation marks.'
decisions.note: Spec-review stage. Quoted exact-phrase search missing from presented search; client requests it -> corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'combine things - like find me anything about Rome that is tagged either article or book ... make sure the search side is designed with that kind of combining in mind, not just a single plain keyword.' R2 maker: 'Combined text, phrase, and tag conditions.'
decisions.note: Spec-review stage. Boolean/grouped combining (matches REF-BM-15 example) missing from presented search; client requests it -> corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'I would expect to be able to mark a link as read this later.' R2 maker: 'Read-later collection with explicit read/unread status.'
decisions.note: Spec-review stage. Read-later (unread) marking absent from R1 covered scope; client requests it -> corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'pull up just those unread ones on their own when I have time.' R2 maker: 'Dedicated unread read-later view.'
decisions.note: Spec-review stage. Separate unread view absent from presented scope; client requests it -> corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'check them off once I have read them.' R2 maker: 'explicit read/unread status.' R5 client verified: 'marking one as read dropped it off that list while keeping it in my library.'
decisions.note: Spec-review stage. Mark-as-read removing from unread list absent from presented scope; client requests it -> corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker excluded scope: 'without ... imports'. R5 client: 'a couple of ideas I might want later ... importing my existing browser bookmarks - but those are wishes for another round, not anything missing from what we agreed. Please just jot them down for the future.'
decisions.note: Divergence presented R1 (import excluded), passed silently at the R2 spec gate, then explicitly named and accepted at R5 implementation review. Client states expected behaviour and accepts the departure -> accepted_divergence. Linked disposition; counted once.

decisions.evidence: Snapshot never presented by maker. R5 client: 'keeping a saved copy of a page in case it disappears ... wishes for another round, not anything missing from what we agreed ... they do not hold up today's version.'
decisions.note: Implementation-review stage. Client explicitly expresses the snapshot/local-copy requirement and accepts its absence -> accepted_divergence. Internet-Archive REF-BM-25 not separately surfaced.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker enumerates retrieved fields: 'Automatic retrieval of page title, description, and site icon' with no preview image; R5 maker: 'Automatic title, description, and site-icon retrieval'. REF-BM-02 also requires a preview image. R2/R5 client approvals never mention preview image.
decisions.note: Separable sub-requirement of REF-BM-02. The auto-collect divergence itself was corrected earlier; the residual preview-image field was presented as omitted and passed without any client expression of the difference -> unexpressed_divergence. Distinct aspect/timing from the corrective REF-BM-02 decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 spec described duplicate handling; R1 client: 'warning me and sending me to the existing bookmark instead of making a copy - is exactly right, so keep that.' R5 client verified it working.
decisions.note: Recorded conforming decision matching REF-BM-06 (re-save converges to editing existing). Client explicitly endorsed; not a divergence.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker covered 'saving, opening, editing, deleting, tagging, searching, filtering, and sorting'. R5 client verified save/reopen, edit, confirm-before-delete, navigate to original, tag filter, base search, and sort all working.
decisions.note: Recorded conforming core CRUD/navigation/base-search/tag-filter/sort decisions; conform to reference, no divergence.
